verdict.rationale: Smithery is an MCP registry and connection platform with a CLI, so a telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out is a fair question for it. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions telemetry, analytics collection, or any opt-out setting. The docs cover OAuth, credential storage, token scoping and publishing, none of which addresses usage tracking.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
